QF.id: VI Depository and its Business Partners_47

question.text: For securities held in demat form, the issuer must inform the depository about corporate action dates by when?

answer.text: On the next day on which the information is being sent to the stock exchanges
At least 30 days before the record date
At least 15 days before the book closure
Within 7 days of the board meeting deciding the corporate action

explanation.text: The Logic: The issuer shall inform the depository on the next day on which the information is being communicated/sent to the relevant stock exchanges where the securities are listed. The Trap: 'At least 30 days before the record date' confuses the exchange notification window with the depository notification timing. Note: The depository needs this information to prepare the list of beneficial owners as of the record date.
